verdict.rationale: All evidence describes US sales tax registration, nexus tracking, calculation, filing, exemption certificates, and marketplace calculations — no mention anywhere of VAT/GST, EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, or Australia regimes or foreign registration thresholds. The 'validate customer VAT IDs live' item is a thin pricing bullet but there is no supporting documentation of actual VAT/GST filing, OSS/IOSS schemes, or global registration threshold tracking.
